messages:
emma: Proposal: dedicated-capacity roadmap PR — add tenant-level quota reconciliation API + 'soft burst' windows + per-pool fairness weights. Needs product decision by EOD Friday. TL;DR: enable predictable burst without blowing committed capacity.
ricardo: Quick question — do we have data on current burst patterns? we need 95p burst size per tenant to size soft windows.
olivia: Draft policy sketch below. intentionally small to iterate; includes fairness and preemption_priority.
```yaml
pool: reserved-gpu-a
burst_window: 300s # soft window
burst_quota: 5 # units (logical)
fairness_weight: tenant_tier
preemption_priority: [reserved, shared]
```
zach: Telemetry ask: need per-tenant burst_count, preemptions, fallback_model_routing. Proposed metrics: `redwood.dedicated.burst.usage`, `redwood.dedicated.burst.preemptions`, `redwood.dedicated.fallback.count`. Also want histograms for burst_size and latency impact.
mike-ops: Ops note: preemption is risky for high-tier SLAs. Recommend opt-in for preemptible tenants + grace window for canaries. Also need a max_preemptions_per_minute guard.
sarah-ce: Customer note: several mid-market accounts asked for predictable billed burst. They'll pay for guaranteed burst blocks. We should include a billable 'burst credits' product and pricing experiment.
product-bot: New doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/dedicated/burst-credit-model (WIP)
emma: Decision proposal: 1) Build quota reconciliation API + metrics (P0), 2) Implement soft-burst window with fairness_weight (P1), 3) Billing integration for burst credits (P2). Rollout: canary to 10 customers (mix of PLG & enterprise) for 2 weeks, measure p50/p95 latency, cost delta, preemptions. If metrics within thresholds -> GA. Owners: ricardo (telemetry), olivia (policy), mike-ops (preemption infra), sarah (customer trials). Anyone object? :eyes:
ricardo: :thumbsup: I'll take telemetry. Quick follow-up: expected storage for per-tenant counters? prefer TSDB counters + rollups vs many per-request writes.
olivia: No objections. I'll spin the sketch into an RFC and include unit + integration tests for fairness logic.
mike-ops: SGTM. We'll prepare rollback playbooks and a dashboard for preemption spikes. Also suggest `max_preemptions_per_minute` as circuit breaker.
sarah-ce: I'll line up two willing customers (one PLG, one enterprise) and draft comms. pricing idea: pack of 10 burst credits/month at introductory rate.
emma: Thanks all — I'll file roadmap ticket and schedule alignment Wed 10am. /remind #product Decision EOD Fri. :rocket:
